mechanism_narrative: Sustained low federal funds rates compress equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20-day horizons as capital flows into equities during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.7%.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates signal labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20-day horizons.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high labor force participation (PAYEMS) and declining industrial production (INDPRO) indicate manufacturing overcapacity, triggering earnings revisions downward and negative equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when PAYEMS > 145k and INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated housing starts (HOUST) reflect strong consumer demand for residential construction, boosting related sector earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20-day horizons.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1200.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust economic activity, increasing corporate profitability and driving positive equity returns over 60-day horizons during expansionary cycles.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2% quarterly.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 245) signals monetary policy tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5-day horizons.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 245.

mechanism_narrative: High employment growth (PAYEMS) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market tightness, fueling wage pressures and inflation, leading to negative equity returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when PAYEMS > 145k and UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rise > 0.1pp monthly) increase discount rates for equity cash flows, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 5-day horizons during policy normalization.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances during FEDFUNDS rise phases.
